text: {"action": "reply", "content": "The general return policy for vacuum cleaners is as follows: an order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered'. You need to confirm the order ID, the list of items to be returned, and a payment method to receive the refund. The refund must either go to the original payment method or an existing gift card. After confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'return requested', and you will receive an email regarding how to return the items. If you decide to return the vacuum cleaner, please let us know the order ID and the item ID, and we can proceed with the return."}
